definitions: To make (a garment, fabric, etc.) by interlocking loops of yarn or thread with knitting needles or a machine.
To join or interlace (threads, parts, or things) closely and firmly.
To unite or grow together, especially of a broken bone.
To draw (the brows) together in a frown or look of concentration.
examples: She likes to knit sweaters for her grandchildren.
The broken bone will knit back together.
He would knit his brows in thought.
